epics.sixSigmaMetric: reduce local environment deployment time from >10 mins to <1 min
requirements: R1: Add a docker-compose.yml or equivalent to start the full stack and expose a health-check endpoint.

slices.title: Implement local containerization stack
slices.jtbd: When implementing docker-compose for this epic, I want to add a docker-compose.yml file, so that the full stack can be started with a single command.
slices.acceptanceCriteria:
Given the repository root
When a developer runs the container start command
Then the full stack boots successfully
And E2E tests verify the health-check endpoint responds with 200 OK
slices.sixSigmaMetric: increase single-command boot success rate from 0% to 100%

epics.sixSigmaMetric: reduce time to correct outdated materials from >5 mins to <1 min via UI
requirements: R1: Implement capability to update existing materials.
R2: Implement capability to delete existing materials.

slices.title: Implement material update and delete in frontend
slices.jtbd: When implementing the frontend changes for this epic, I want to add edit and delete actions, so that materials can be updated and deleted.
slices.acceptanceCriteria:
Given an existing material in the catalog
When a user chooses to edit or delete it from the UI
Then the frontend invokes the corresponding API endpoint and updates the view
And frontend integration tests verify the state update
slices.sixSigmaMetric: increase CRUD frontend component test coverage from 50% to 100%

epics.title: System Authentication and Authorization
epics.jtbd: When accessing the knowledge base, I want to authenticate my identity, so that restricted epidemiological protocols and data are protected from unauthorized access or modification.
epics.sixSigmaMetric: reduce unauthorized access incidents from >0 to 0 per week
requirements: R1: Prevent unauthenticated access to the catalog and material creation endpoints.

slices.title: Enforce authentication on protected routes
slices.jtbd: When implementing authentication checks for this epic, I want to protect the catalog and creation endpoints, so that the knowledge base remains secure.
slices.acceptanceCriteria:
Given an unauthenticated user
When they attempt to access the catalog or create a material
Then they are blocked and prompted to log in
And automated E2E security tests verify the denial of access
slices.sixSigmaMetric: increase protected route test coverage from 0% to 100%
